title: Bobo's Pinwheel Surprise
character_reference: Joyful Bobo Monkey Profile Portrait.png from the Library: golden-brown fur, spiky tuft, large brown eyes and rounded ears, red shirt. Preserve the same recognizable monkey; no bear/overalls substitution.

scene_reference.note: A matching rooftop-pinwheel scene image was generated from the Library Bobo portrait, but the binary image has not been committed to GitHub; do not run generation until the reference is present in the repository.

premise: Bobo gives a colorful pinwheel one gentle puff; a breeze spins it faster than expected, then it slows and he proudly presents it.

voice_placement.final_timing_source: dialogue-timing.json measured from the rendered Piper track and the observed final reaction
voice_placement.note: Do not treat the planned start as verified; reposition only after observing the rendered action.

shots.action: Bobo raises the rainbow pinwheel immediately and gives one gentle puff. The blades begin visibly spinning; he keeps the wooden handle steady.
required_evidence: Bobo visibly blows toward the pinwheel
The pinwheel blades visibly start turning
shots.end_pose: Bobo holds the pinwheel upright while its blades continue turning.

shots.action: A light breeze makes the pinwheel spin faster and wobble. Bobo adjusts his grip and follows the moving blades with his eyes and upper body, remaining lively.
required_evidence: Pinwheel rotation visibly changes speed or wobbles
Bobo makes a purposeful grip adjustment
No prolonged stationary anticipation or unrelated prop
shots.end_pose: The pinwheel begins to slow while Bobo steadies the handle.

shots.action: The pinwheel slows. Bobo steadies it, turns it toward the camera, points at it and gives a small shoulder wiggle. He says the brief line 'Wind power!' during the observed reaction.
required_evidence: Bobo steadies and presents the same pinwheel
Spoken line is rendered by local Piper and independently verified in the final encoded mix
shots.end_pose: Bobo and the pinwheel remain visible together.

caption_policy: Do not invent action captions from planned beats. Add only the exact spoken subtitle until observed-action onset/completion is measured; inspect each transition at 8 fps.
effects_note: No arbitrary boings, pitch sweeps or celebration chimes. Add only restrained natural foley after the rendered contact/action is observed and a free source is verified; no subjective realism claim without listening.
music_policy: Select a distinct instrument/style variant not used in the last three published videos and preserve it through all repairs.
